parameters: Sergeant Barnabas, we've got another one. Get your men organized and ready to deploy in two hours.
...Do you have a problem with that, Sergeant?
No, sir. The Army is being put to good use, sir.
And try to clean the uniforms up a bit before your men shut that place down. The war's over. The public has eyes on everything we do.
With what resources, sir? We barely got enough coin to keep our boys from choppin' my head off in a mutiny as is. You tellin' me we're to worry about spit 'n polish now too?
Just find a way, Sergeant. Put down that paperwork and do it your damn self if you have to.\! We're all on tight budgets. Don't think my superiors haven't kicked me around lately. As you were.
...Whoa there, small fry! Who let ya in here?
Hey, don't sweat it, kid! Get on home now, your folks are probably worried sick.
Damn...\| thought so. Was hopin' you had a home to go to.
Please let me clean your uniforms, sir...
I ain't got nothin' to pay ya, kiddo. It ain't worth spendin' the energy.
There's supplies in the basement. Maybe the shields could have a bit more shine to 'em.
...Looks like I lost my appetite too. Guess someone'll have to take my lunch so it don't go bad. It's nothin' special but it fills ya up...
